jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst (1099 Contract)
jobs.salary: $55–$65/hour, six-month 1099 contract (approximately $114,400–$135,200 annualized at 40 hours/week; no guaranteed annual salary or benefits)
jobs.why: 2+ years BSA requirement aligns with Orion BA tenure; gather and document requirements, translate business needs for engineering, work with stakeholders, and organize complex data. Strong traditional business systems overlap.
jobs.gap: Six-month 1099 engagement with no guaranteed benefits; insurance carrier and underwriting knowledge absent; Jira and Confluence not used at Orion; technical specifications for insurance product configurations are a stretch.
